_README: Per-million-token prices, each stamped with the date it was read off the
vendor's own pricing page. cost_ledger.Rate.is_stale() flags anything older
than the configured window, because a ceiling computed from unchecked prices
These are STANDARD tier, prompts under 200k tokens. Batch, flex, and priority
tiers differ; so does long-context pricing above 200k. If a run ever sends a
prompt over 200k tokens these numbers are wrong and the ceiling is too loose.
Re-check every 90 days. Vendors change prices without notice.

seat_2._note: standard tier, prompts <= 200k. Above 200k it is $4.00/$18.00.

seat_3._note: Mistral Medium 3.5, standard regional inference tier.

seat_5._note: base input / output. Cache reads are 0.1x input if caching is ever enabled.
